workData.title: coe
workData.subTitle: Designed the brand and UX/UI for coe, enabling AI-driven human rights risk analysis to drive corporate accountability.

content.text: In response to the growing focus on “Business and Human Rights,” coe launched a service to eliminate human rights violations by capturing workers’ voices and assessing corporate human rights risks.
Using AI, coe analyzes data from internal and external sources to uncover hidden risks, evaluate severity, and prioritize improvements, streamlining human rights due diligence for companies.

As the Lead Product Designer from the project’s inception, I created the brand design system, service-related designs, and UX/UI for web and app interfaces. Currently, I continue to enhance features and develop new functionalities to ensure coe evolves into an essential platform that empowers workers, transforms corporate behavior, and contributes to a better world.

coe provides a platform for workers to anonymously and safely report workplace concerns. It addresses challenges like hesitance to use company consultation channels by offering a secure and user-friendly solution.
: Ensures workers can safely share concerns.
: Identifies human rights risks and prioritizes solutions.
: Provides content to raise awareness and support learning.
A secure, intuitive platform will encourage workers to participate and share concerns.
AI-powered analysis will help companies address issues efficiently.
A trustworthy brand design will build confidence among workers and companies.
A cohesive design system emphasizing transparency and trust was created to engage workers and companies alike.
The interfaces were designed for simplicity, anonymity, and ease of use, with secure messaging and educational content to enhance engagement.
AI analyzes worker feedback, delivering actionable risk assessments to help companies prioritize improvements.
: Anonymity and security empowered workers to voice concerns without fear.
: AI-enabled companies to identify and address risks effectively.
: Educational content fostered understanding of human rights issues.
: A reliable design system earned credibility with workers and companies.
: Anonymity and safety were key to encouraging participation.
: AI-powered insights streamlined communication and problem-solving.
: Addressing both worker and corporate needs was critical for success.
coe continues to amplify workers’ voices and drive corporate transformation. As lead designer, I remain dedicated to refining features and adding value to support its mission.

next.title: SOUND ON LIVE
next.subTitle: Designed an innovative website for SOUND ON LIVE, translating music into dynamic visuals for an immersive, inspiring experience.

content.text: “SOUND ON LIVE” is a design firm where music artists collaborate to create a website that visually represents music in an innovative way. The goal was to capture the beauty of music while delivering a design that amazes and inspires.
As the lead designer, I handled the concept, wireframes, design, and art direction for the project.
The challenge was to craft a dynamic website that visually embodies music. The design aimed to synchronize visuals with music to create a captivating and emotional experience.
Dynamic, interactive visuals would convey the essence of music and engage users.
Animations and responsive design would enhance the sensory connection.
A balanced layout and color scheme would amplify the overall impact.
The website features particles that morph and change color in harmony with music, creating an interactive and immersive experience.
Through brainstorming and trial and error, we refined ideas to align with the project’s vision.
Careful adjustments to layout, color, and animation speed enhanced simplicity and impact.
Successfully captured the joy and beauty of music through dynamic visuals.
Demonstrated innovation by combining technical creativity with music synchronization.
Delivered a memorable and impactful experience that aligned with the client’s vision.
Balancing creativity with usability is key to impactful designs.
Iterative refinement ensures cohesion in dynamic projects.
Collaboration with the client is vital for achieving a shared vision.
This project highlighted the potential of combining art and technology to create immersive digital experiences that celebrate music.
